anaSayfa.baslik: The toolkit that takes the repetition out of CATIA
anaSayfa.aciklama: A desktop toolkit that takes over repetitive work in 3DEXPERIENCE (CATIA V6). Sheet metal part lists, batch DXF export, weight and cost calculation — all in one window.
anaSayfa.ogAciklama: A desktop toolkit that brings repetitive CATIA work into a single window.

indir.aciklama: Download Macria: a single file with no installer, file verification details, and release notes for every version.

destek.aciklama: Macria is free and open source. A support option for those who want to contribute voluntarily to its development.

hero.aciklama: Macria connects to the assembly you already have open in 3DEXPERIENCE and does the repetitive work for you. No installation, works offline.

kapilar.metin: One click on a hundred-part assembly.
Thickness and quantity on one screen.

pipeline.aciklama: Whichever tool you use, the flow is the same — and it will stay the same as the toolkit grows. Open the app; if the assembly is already open in 3DEXPERIENCE, the rest follows on its own.

adimlar.metin: Connects over COM to your running 3DEXPERIENCE (CATIA V6) session. On corporate machines where the ProgID is missing, it falls back to a CLSID and ROT scan.
Walks the active assembly's product tree end to end, picks out the sheet metal parts and rolls up duplicates as quantities.
Product name, part name, thickness and quantity in one table. You choose the columns and add your own formula columns.
Runs the tool you pick: it drives the panels for you during DXF export, and computes the table in the cost tool. The always-on-top progress window and the emergency stop stay within reach.

features.aciklama: Instead of hunting for a separate macro file for every job, they all live in one window. The list below is ready today — and it gets longer with every release.

kartlar.metin: Export every sheet metal part in the list with a single click. The always-on-top progress window shows where it is, and the emergency stop is always within reach.
Walks the active assembly's tree end to end and collects the parts you're after, merging duplicates into quantities. Every other tool works on top of this list.
Weight from thickness, flat pattern area and material density; cost from the unit price. Mild steel, galvanised, Hardox, stainless and aluminium come built in.
See the flat pattern inside the exported file before you open it. Did it come out empty, is it the shape you expected — you can tell at a glance.
Add your own column to the table and build a calculation from the other columns. Functions like min, max, sqrt and round work under both their English and Turkish names.
Numeric cells are shaded within their own column, so the most expensive, heaviest and thickest part stands out the moment you look at the list.
See the distribution as a chart and export the result to Excel or PDF. Charts are drawn inside the app, with no external library.
A single portable exe. It asks for no administrator rights and looks for no internet connection — it even runs from a USB stick on an air-gapped machine.

oneri.metin: If there's something you do by hand every day, tell us — let that be the next thing added to the toolkit.

dxf.baslik: One Click, Even On A Hundred Parts.
dxf.aciklama: Instead of opening parts one by one and hitting "Save As DXF", select the list and start. Macria drives the panels for you, and a small window showing which part it's on stays above every other application.
maddeler: The selected part or the whole list
Open the folder as soon as the export finishes

maliyet.baslik: Don't Wait On A Spreadsheet To Quote.
maliyet.aciklama: You already have the flat pattern area, the thickness and the material density. Macria combines them and gives you the weight and cost of every part alongside the list. Change the material and the whole table recalculates instantly.
maliyet.not: Densities come built into the app; you can add an alloy that isn't in the list yourself. The unit price is yours — the values here are only an example.

gelistiriciler.aciklama: Macria is built by engineers who use CATIA on the job. For questions and collaboration, reach out on LinkedIn.

kapanis.baslik: Use It On Your Next Assembly.
kapanis.aciklama: No installer, a single portable file, works offline. The download page also has the file verification details and the release history.
